 Judgment

The appeal is filed by the claimants against the Judgment and Award dated 27.07.2021 passed in MVC No.1895/2019 by the XII Addl. District and Sessions Judge, Belagavi, sitting at Gokak, for enhancement of compensation.

entities.text: XII Addl. District and Sessions Judge, Belagavi
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 2. The factum of the accident, injuries sustained by the claimants and liability are not disputed.

3. Heard the learned counsel for both sides and perused the records.
4.
The Tribunal has granted compensation under various heads as follows:
Sl . No
. Heads

. Amount  ( in Rs.)
 1. Loss of dependency 19,37,988/-
 2. Loss of consortium 70,000/-
 3. Cost of litigation & 10,000/-
 conveyance
Upon considering the parameters held by the Tribunal, compensation of Rs.19,37,988/- awarded under the head loss of dependency is found to be correct.
It is kept in tact.
The compensation of Rs.10,000/- awarded under the head litigation expenses is kept in tact.
6. The claimants are wife and two children of deceased.

In view of the decision of the Hon'ble Supreme Court in the case of Magma General Insurance Co. Limited v. Nanu Ram & Others,
reported in 2018 ACJ 2782 and in the case of Pranay Sethi supra, the claimants are entitled to Rs.40,000/- each under the head loss of consortium, along with 10% escalation.

entities.text:
Magma General Insurance Co. Limited v. Nanu Ram & Others,
reported in 2018 ACJ 2782
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
Accordingly,
Rs.1,32,000/- (Rs.40,000 x 3 + 10%) is awarded under the head loss of consortium including loss of love and affection.

7. Further, a sum of Rs.16,500/- is awarded under the head 'loss of estate' and a sum of Rs.16,500/-
under the head 'transportation of dead body, funeral expenses, etc'.

3 8. Thus, the claimants would be entitled for compensation under various heads as under:
 Sl. Heads. Amount in  No. (Rs.)
 1. Towards loss of dependency 19,37,988/-
 (kept in tact)
 2. Towards loss of consortium 1,32,000/-

3 . Towards loss of estate 16,500/-
 4. Transportation of dead body & 16,500/-
 funeral expenses.
 4. Litigation expenses 10,000/-

Total: 21,12,988/-
Less: Compensation awarded by 20,18,000/-
tribunal:
Enhanced compensation: 94,988/-
9.

In the result, I proceed to pass the following:
ORDER i.
The appeal is allowed-in-part.
ii. The judgment and award passed by the Tribunal in dated 27.07.2021 passed in MVC No.1895/2019 by the XII Addl.

District and Sessions Judge, Belagavi, sitting at Gokak, is hereby modified that the claimants are entitled for enhanced compensation of NC: 2023:KHC-D:10653 Rs.94,988/- with interest @ 6% p.a., from the date of petition till its realization, in addition to what has been awarded by the Tribunal.
iii. The claimants are not entitled for interest for the delayed period of 16 days in filing the appeal.

iv. Costs made easy.
v. Registry to send back TCR along with a copy of this Judgment to the Tribunal, forthwith.
vi. Draw the award accordingly.

SD/-
